text.tspan: S7 Jetson power switches, readbacks, link and carrier (version 3)
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · EPS side: SQSO-EPS-BRD-001 8.3 · OBC side: SQSO-OBC-BRD-001 11 (RIDs AV-06, AV-09) · carrier: SQSO-JET-BRD-001 · pins: SQSO-ICX-001
Readbacks measure each switch's output (VBAT / 6: 1.87-2.80 V on, < 0.1 V off), not its command. The two
enables are on different MCU ports, so one port-register upset cannot set both. PB4 (the firmware's pin) resets as
NJTRST with a pull-up and would switch SW1 on at every OBC reset; PB2 has no reset pull.
RID AV-09: the translators' carrier side is powered by the carrier's own 3.3 V I/O rail on J3-4. With the carrier
off, VCCB = 0 V and both ports are high-impedance (VCC isolation, Ioff): the idle-high TX cannot back-power the
module, whatever the firmware does. The carrier must provide its 3.3 V rail on its pin 4 (<= 1 mA).
JET_PG is the third readback (RID AV-06): the carrier's converter is running.
Carrier (SQSO-JET-BRD-001): VBAT_JET -> 5 V VDD_IN (Orin Nano: 4.75-5.25 V only, DS-11105-001 Table 5-1)
3V3_IO -> 100 Ohm -> J2-4 JET_3V3; U9 -> 1V8_IO; U10/U11 VCCB
U10/U11 SN74LVC1T45-Q1 (VCCA 1V8_IO, VCCB 3V3_IO): module UART1 TXD pin 203 -> J2-3, J2-2 -> RXD pin 205 (1.8 V CMOS).
JET_3V3 rises only after the module's power sequence (SYS_RESET* high) and falls within 0.1 ms of a carrier trip or
a module shutdown: the carrier power-good (AV-06). No module I/O sees > 0.5 V before SYS_RESET* (DS 3.6.1; AV-09).
J2-5/-6: spreader NTC passed through to the OBC (change E10). Storage: M.2 2230 NVMe on PCIe C4 (3V3_SSD via U8).
